Found 37,076 / 27,941 / 9,135 augmented faces, 18,536 / 13,969 / 4,567 matched pairs, and complete directed topological sorts over 219,240 / 162,087 / 48,018 incidences. Remaining augmented cells: four dimension-5, three dimension-5, one dimension-4; one pair contains empty face each. Removing that pair yields an ordinary critical vertex plus higher cells, so Forman implies ∨4S⁵, ∨3S⁵, S⁴ integrally. The link S⁴→∨3S⁵ is null since target 4-connected, and the vertex cofibration splits; transitivity proves uniformity. Exhaustive finite certificate is valid for THIS finite graph, not any infinite family.
